comment: D-SINK-79 (2026-11-05): the guide's whitespace fold never folds inside a URL's run, and the shell
folds a detail only after it redacts it. tests/test_epg_fold.py runs `cases` through the helper's
parse_xmltv and its sinks, and `fold` through fold_space; tests/Model.test.js runs `cases` through
the shell's sinks, and `rawDetail` through programmeDetail. Every expected value is written from
the rule, by hand, in the generator (the review's F9 and F11 of 2026-11-06 among them). `kind` is
three URL forms and four fields), `ordinary`, or `cut` (D-SINK-75's cap). `stored` is what the
helper stores for the field, `helper` is redact_urls of it, `shell` Model.sinkText of it, and
`panel` what programmeDetail shows (null: absent). The credential is spelt in letters nothing
else here holds: any of `secret` in a sink is a leak. ASCII only: every other character is a
